name: UploadDocument
label: Upload Document
description: Uploads a document to Salesforce as a ContentVersion (Salesforce File).

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: Title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The title of the document to upload

fields.name: FileContent
fields.label: File Content
fields.description: The binary content of the file to upload

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: File Name
fields.description: The name of the file (e.g., 'report.pdf'). If not provided, defaults to 'document.dat'.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.label: Parent Record ID
fields.description: Optional: The ID of the record to link this file to (e.g., Lead, Account).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce after upload
